prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, wolf cut chocolate brown hair — wearing a pale pink faux-fur micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully covering her, paired with a strapless thick pale pink faux-fur bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, no other garment on her chest, her stomach fully visible below it. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, slightly darker skin over her elbows and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. Pose: sitting on a giant toadstool cap with her legs stretched out to one side and crossed at the ankles, leaning back on both hands planted behind her, chest lifted, chin raised, her legs fully in view — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of pale pink faux fur, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, in pale pink faux fur with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a mossy forest floor in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: gigantic red toadstool mushrooms with white spots as tall as trees, giant curled ferns, a giant brown snail with a spiral shell resting nearby, a softly blurred sun-dappled forest far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on the edge of a toadstool cap with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by soft green-gold forest light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous toadstools, ferns and snail around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
